# Verovio browser asset

`verovio.js` is the browser asset used by the historical combined Web App in
`../miku-score`. During the repository split it is copied here so browser
loading and single-file embedding are owned by `miku-score-web`.

The expected SHA-256 is recorded in `verovio.sha256` and verified during every
build. Update the asset and digest together in one reviewed change.
